name: IPinfo
tagline: IP address geolocation, ASN, company, and privacy data API
description: IPinfo provides IP intelligence APIs for geolocation (city, region, country, coordinates), ASN/network ownership, company data, privacy/VPN/proxy detection, and related IP metadata. Developers query by IP address (or use a tokenized client IP lookup) and receive structured JSON. Plans range from a free tier with limited fields and request volume to paid tiers with higher limits and richer datasets.

auth.details: API token via ?token= query parameter or Authorization: Bearer header; free self-serve signup at ipinfo.io/signup

pricing.free_tier_limits: 50,000 requests/month free (Basic/Lite-style free tier; limited data fields vs paid)
pricing.paid_plans: Paid plans for higher volume and full datasets (Core, Plus, Business, Enterprise) — see pricing page

rate_limits: Free tier typically ~50k/month; paid plans higher; daily/minute limits vary by plan — check current pricing
use_cases: geolocate a user IP to country/city for localization
look up ASN and network owner for an IP
detect VPN/proxy/hosting for fraud or abuse checks
enrich server logs with IP location metadata
resolve client IP geolocation for content routing
